annotations.title: Token verdict: is this token safe? (graded A-F)

description: Answers "Is this token a scam?", "Is it safe to ape into this?", "Rug pull risk?" or "Should my agent accept this token as payment?" in one short answer. Send a token contract address on Base (default) or Ethereum. The service reads the contract and its DEX liquidity on-chain (owner powers such as minting, blacklisting, pausing, fees and trading switches; upgradeability; renounced ownership; Uniswap and Aerodrome liquidity; OFAC sanctions) and returns a grade: A (solid), B (no flags, modest liquidity), C (read the cautions), D (serious risks) or F (avoid: no liquidity, sanctioned or high-risk), a one-liner under 70 characters, a two-sentence take, the red flags and good signs, liquidity in USD and a 0-100 risk score, plus a sell test: a simulated buy from the biggest pool and sell back into it (nothing is sent on-chain) that catches honeypots and hidden buy/sell taxes. For every detail, token_risk_check returns the full evidence. Not financial advice. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.009 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

address.description: The token contract, e.g. 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 (USDC on Base).

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
